greeting: Morning, Dan. The calendar's clear and the Fredericksburg stay ends tomorrow, so today is really the move from Virginia down to the St. Pete cottage, girls along.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority board task, overdue since Sep 14: a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week. Holiday inventory at PWM sells out, so a refundable hold now costs nothing and takes the risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Open on the Mike + Dan board since Sep 30, and the book-by-Oct-15 window has already passed. Six people across three holiday weeks is the thinnest inventory of the year; a domestic pick clears it fastest.
